name: line-messaging-mcp
description: LINE (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_line_channel_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_line_channel_access_token.description: Channel access token of the Messaging API channel (long-lived token from the LINE Developers Console, or a short-lived / v2.1 token), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {channel access token}' (securitySchemes Bearer 'Channel access token' in LINE's official OpenAPI description, https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml; https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#send-push-message).

tools.name: me
tools.description: 'Get bot info' — account carries userId ('Bot's user ID'), basicId, premiumId, displayName, pictureUrl, chatMode (chat | bot) and markAsReadMode (auto | manual).

tools.name: send
tools.description: 'Sends a message to a user, group chat, or multi-person chat at any time': `to` is the userId, groupId or roomId ('ID of the receiver'), `text` becomes messages[0] = {type: 'text', text} ('Max character limit: 5000'); `subject` and `channel` are ignored. Users must have added the LINE Official Account (or share the group / room) and push messages consume the plan's monthly quota. message_id is sentMessages[0].id ('ID of the sent message'); quoteToken sits under raw.sentMessages[0].
